Criteria for Approval:
• Diagnosis of growth hormone deficiency; AND
• Pediatric patient must NOT have closed epiphyses if used for longitudinal growth promotion; AND
• Patient does NOT have active malignancy; AND
• Patient does NOT have active proliferative or severe non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy; AND
• Patient does NOT have Prader-Willi syndrome with ≥ 1 of the following:
○ Severe obesity
○ History of upper airway obstruction or sleep apnea
○ Severe respiratory impairment
○ Unidentified respiratory infection; AND
• NPD criteria.

Renewal Criteria:
• Patient continues to meet the above criteria; AND
• Patient has a positive response compared to pre-treatment baseline.

Age Limit: ≥ 3 years
